meta.title: A Draft Note (Should Not Be Public)
meta.summary: An unpublished draft used to verify that drafts are ingested but excluded from all public queries.

data.text: This post has published: false, so it must be ingested into the cache but never returned by any public endpoint — not in the list, not by slug, not in search, and its tag must not appear in the published tag counts.
The unique word quokka appears only here, so searching for it should return nothing from the public search endpoint.
